requirements.text: A MgaObject has one String attribute called name
A FSM (may) have a state machine
A root folder has a name
A FiniteStateMachine has a class that is an AssociationStateState
A transition has one and only one a state machine.
A state has one and only one StateMachine
A state has one or more association state source
A state machine has one and only one root folder
A state machine may have a transition or many or not
A root folder may have root folders, potentially many.
An association state has one and only one transition
An association state has one or many source state
